plain_text:
LIBRARY BOARD of COMMISSIONERS 
Wednesday, November 18, 2026, 7:45 am 
Minutes 
 
Present: Gale Batsimm, Sally Blanchard-O’Brien, Emily Copeland, Mary Danko, Samantha Donalds, Patrick 
Halladay, Carol Livingston, Cate MacLachlan, Amy Mellencamp, Wells Shelley, Lydia Spinner, Nick Tatakis, Rebecca 
Thompson, Shana Trombley, Mona Tolba. 
 
Approval of minutes: from September 19. Mona Tolba moved, Rebecca Thompson seconded, approved. 
 
Approval of agenda: Emily Copeland moved, Sam Donalds seconded, approved. 
 
Public Forum: Sara Forward  
 
Friends of FFL Report: Carol Livingston reported that the Friends will host two book sales the weekend of 
December 5-6 at the library and at the Good Trade Maker’s Market at the Doubletree. The Friends are seeking 
temporary space during the capital project. 
Director’s Report: Mary and her team have met with CEDO to discuss rental properties during the capital project. 
The Building Committee meets regularly. CMAR approval passed through the Board of Finance, waiting for contract 
approval from the City Attorney’s office. Megan Butterfield, Youth Services Manager, presented to REI B on library 
programs and services for youth. The library will be open for limited service noon to 4 pm on Thanksgiving and 
Christmas and will be distributing meals. The Non-Fiction Comics Festival drew 950 people to the library. New staff 
appointments include Hayley Martin as the new Circulation Manager and Kelli Young-Kravitz as the Teen Librarian. 
Homecard and Reciprocal Borrowing have expanded patron options. 
Library Report:. Shana Trombley reported on the Capital Campaign. The project cost has escalated to $41M but 
the CMAR, architects and building committee will be value engineering to keep the total at the $35M project goal. 
The Capital Campaign Committee currently has $20.1M raised. The Friends are negotiating with the City for 
municipal support, which may include a bond and monies from the capital fund. The bond vote would likely go 
before City Council on December 7 and 14. 
Subcommittee update: Policy Committee will be meeting in December. 
New/Other Business: none 
Next meeting: January 20 at 7:45 a.m. 
Adjournment: Sally Blanchard-O’Brien moved, Patrick Halladay seconded. Approved.
